scheme_name: Promotion of Energy Audit and Conservation of Energy (PEACE): Incentive for Implementing Energy Audit Recommendations
other_conditions: All manufacturing MSMEs in Tamil Nadu are eligible
The MSME must have undertaken an energy audit and achieved at least 10% energy savings measured as units of energy consumed per unit of product over the last 12‑month average
Enterprises with more than one unit can claim the concession separately for each unit
There must be a minimum gap of three years between the previous energy audit and the current one
Savings are calculated on a twelve‑month average before implementation and a three‑month average after implementation
benefits_summary: A subsidy of 50% of eligible component costs, up to ₹10,00,000, is provided for each implementation of energy audit recommendations.
